parameters.formDescription: Paste the URL of the YouTube video you want to check for potential unauthorized reuse.

parameters.jsCode:
const candidate = $json;

return {
  json: {
    status: "ORIGINAL_VIDEO",
    is_original: true,

    submitted_video_id: candidate.original_video_id || "",
    submitted_video_url: candidate.original_video_url || "",

    authorized_channel_id: candidate.authorized_channel_id || "",
    authorized_channel_name: candidate.authorized_channel_name || "",
    authorized_channel_handle: candidate.authorized_channel_handle || "",

    matched_video_id: candidate.matched_video_id || "",
    matched_video_url: candidate.matched_url || "",

    matched_title: candidate.matched_title || "",
    matched_channel_id: candidate.matched_channel_id || "",
    matched_channel_name: candidate.matched_channel_name || "",

    duration: candidate.duration || "",
    view_count: candidate.view_count || 0,
    like_count: candidate.like_count || 0,
    comment_count: candidate.comment_count || 0,

    copyright_score: candidate.copyright_score || 0,
    risk_level: "ORIGINAL",

    scan_reasons: candidate.scan_reasons || [],

    message: "This video matches the original submitted video."
  }
};

const item = $json;

return {
  json: {
    status: item.status || "UNKNOWN",

    submitted_video_id: item.submitted_video_id || "",
    submitted_video_url: item.submitted_video_url || "",

    authorized_channel_id: item.authorized_channel_id || "",
    authorized_channel_name: item.authorized_channel_name || "",
    authorized_channel_handle: item.authorized_channel_handle || "",

    matched_video_id: item.matched_video_id || "",
    matched_video_url: item.matched_video_url || "",
    matched_title: item.matched_title || "",
    matched_channel_id: item.matched_channel_id || "",
    matched_channel_name: item.matched_channel_name || "",
    matched_published_at: item.matched_published_at || "",

    copyright_score: item.copyright_score || 0,
    risk_level: item.risk_level || "",
    scan_reasons: item.scan_reasons || [],

    message: item.message || ""
  }
};

const item = $json;

return {
  json: {
    status: "NO_COPYRIGHT_MATCH",

    submitted_video_id: item.submitted_video_id || "",
    submitted_video_url: item.submitted_video_url || "",

    authorized_channel_id: item.authorized_channel_id || "",
    authorized_channel_name: item.authorized_channel_name || "",
    authorized_channel_handle: item.authorized_channel_handle || "",

    matched_video_id: item.matched_video_id || "",
    matched_video_url: item.matched_video_url || "",
    matched_title: item.matched_title || "",
    matched_channel_id: item.matched_channel_id || "",
    matched_channel_name: item.matched_channel_name || "",
    matched_published_at: item.matched_published_at || "",

    copyright_score: item.copyright_score || 0,
    risk_level: item.risk_level || "",
    scan_reasons: item.scan_reasons || [],

    message: "No significant copyright match detected."
  }
};
